scenes.script: Rahul says: Bina freeze hue actually English bolna kaise seekhein? Yeh ek aisa question hai jo hum sabke paas hai.
Rahul says: Chahe job interview clear karna ho, promotion paana ho, ya bas confident feel karna ho...
Rahul says: Dusron ke samne respect earn karne aur stand out karne ke liye English ki zaroorat hoti hi hai.
Rahul says: Par purane methods fail ho gaye kyunki aap sirf books padhte the, kabhi actually bolte nahi the. Aur coaching classes mein time bhi bohot lagta hai.
Rahul says: Isiliye aapko zaroorat hai Supernova AI ki. Miliye Miss Nova se, jo hain aapki personal AI English teacher.
Rahul says: Miss Nova ke saath aap out loud bolkar practice karte hain. Chahe 1000 mistakes karo, woh bina judge kiye ya hase aapko correct karengi.
Rahul says: Woh sabko ek hi tarike se nahi padhaati. Woh aapka exact level samajhkar aapke liye ek personalized plan ready karti hain.
Rahul says: Feeds scroll karte hue ghanton waste karna band karo, aur un 1 crore+ Indians ko join karo jo pehle se seekh rahe hain.
Rahul says: Jab woh aapki mistakes correct karti hain, toh logic Hindi mein samjhati hain, taaki sab kuch easily samajh aa jaye.

parsed.self_critique_fixed: Successfully localized the script into Romanized, code-mixed Hindi following the 'Authority / stage monologue' register. Applied the hook rule (T7) to open Scene 1 with a native word ('Bina'). Followed the stay-English list (T2) for product terms, brand names, and numbers (using numerals like '1000', '1 crore+', '15'). Performed the language self-reference swap (T5) in Scene 9, changing 'your own language' to 'Hindi'. Maintained a warm, respectful yet conversational tone for Rahul addressing the viewer, and ensured Miss Nova is referred to with polite plural verbs. No brand safety conflicts or reviewer comments were present.
